sourceOfTruth: Machine-readable task queue for active and upcoming agent work. Human-readable roadmap lives in docs/NEXT_STEPS.md.

tasks.summary: Lock the Cloudflare Pages + Supabase launch architecture and cost model.
acceptance: Launch target records Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Pages Functions for API endpoints, Supabase for data/auth/storage, and an Urblo-owned admin interface.
Current implementation reality remains explicit so agents do not assume backend features already exist.
Monthly cost baseline and optional cost drivers are documented for client planning.

tasks.summary: Design the Supabase schema for Projects, Stone Library, Products, Articles, media, and lead capture.
acceptance: Content entities and relationships are specified before migration work begins, including Products as a customer-maintained content type.
Draft/published/archive status, slug uniqueness, ordering, audit fields, and public read rules are included.
RLS expectations and service-role boundaries are recorded before any public API or admin implementation.

tasks.summary: Implement Cloudflare Pages deployment, preview, function routing, and rollback runbook.
acceptance: Repo-side Cloudflare Pages build command, output directory, SPA fallback, function routing, and launch headers are documented and verified locally.
Only future API routes are configured to invoke Pages Functions; static site traffic remains static.
Clean URL direct refresh works locally for declared routes.
Cloudflare Pages project creation, preview URL validation, production custom domain, DNS cutover, and rollback require account access before this task can be marked done.

tasks.summary: Replace mailto-only Contact and Sample Request flows with Supabase-backed submissions.
notes: 2026-05-22 full-site QA confirmed Contact page copy is clear about opening an email draft, but Sample Request and other mailto CTAs still need consistent fallback wording until Supabase submissions are live.
acceptance: Public form submissions are validated server-side, protected by Turnstile, stored in Supabase, and notify Urblo by email.
Admin users can view and update enquiry and sample-request status.
Visitor success and failure states are clear, and no submitted lead depends only on a local email client.

tasks.summary: Build the Urblo admin CMS for customer-maintained Projects, Stone Library, Products, Articles, media, and leads.
notes: 2026-05-22: This is an umbrella launch objective, not a directly executable single-pass implementation task. Execute through the smaller admin IA, auth/RLS, content CRUD, media, and lead-management tasks below.
acceptance: Authenticated admin users can create, read, update, delete, draft, and publish Projects, Stone Library records, Products, Articles, and media records without code edits.
Article editing uses approved structured block types instead of arbitrary newsletter HTML.
Unpublished content remains hidden from the public site, and unauthenticated users cannot access admin routes.

tasks.summary: Define executable admin IA, access states, and module rollout sequence before building CRUD.
notes: This is the no-secret admin task to run before Supabase credentials are available. It turns the admin umbrella into concrete route, permission, and module contracts without pretending backend auth exists.
2026-05-25: Completed in docs/ADMIN_IA_ACCESS.md with route map, access states, role behavior, module rollout sequence, field ownership model, dashboard health checks, and implementation boundaries.
2026-05-25: No runtime /admin route was added because Supabase Auth, admin profiles, RLS, Storage policies, form endpoints, and secrets are still unavailable.
acceptance: Admin route map is explicit, including unauthenticated, authenticated, unauthorized, loading, and draft/published states.
Module rollout sequence is recorded for leads, media, Stone Library, Projects, Products, and Articles.
Each content type has a first-pass field ownership model: editable by customer, computed by system, or developer-only until migration.
Follow-up implementation tasks remain blocked wherever Supabase project credentials, RLS, Storage, Turnstile, or email secrets are required.

tasks.summary: Implement Supabase Auth, RLS, and the protected Urblo admin shell.
notes: Blocked until Supabase project URL, anon key, service-role handling plan, and admin user policy are available.
Use docs/ADMIN_IA_ACCESS.md for the protected admin shell route map, access states, and role behavior once Supabase credentials are available.
acceptance: Admin shell route is protected by Supabase Auth.
Unauthenticated and unauthorized users cannot access admin content.
RLS policies are enabled and verified for public-read and admin-write boundaries.
Admin session behavior is documented and covered by browser or Playwright checks.

tasks.summary: Implement admin CRUD modules for Projects, Stone Library, Products, and Articles.
notes: Blocked until the admin auth/RLS shell and Supabase content tables are available. Article editing must use structured blocks, not raw newsletter HTML.
Use docs/ADMIN_IA_ACCESS.md for module sequencing and field ownership when implementing Projects, Stone Library, Products, and Articles CRUD.
acceptance: Admin users can draft, publish, edit, archive, and delete Projects, Stone Library records, Products, and Articles.
Public routes expose only published content and preserve current route contracts.
Article CRUD uses approved structured blocks and strips newsletter artifacts from the authoring model.
Static file-backed data sources have a documented migration or fallback path.

tasks.summary: Implement admin media library and lead-management workflow.
notes: Blocked until Supabase Storage, form submission endpoints, Turnstile verification, and transactional email secrets are available.
Use docs/ADMIN_IA_ACCESS.md for lead inbox, media library, status, export, and role behavior when Supabase Storage/forms/email secrets are available.
acceptance: Admin users can manage uploaded media records with source, alt text, usage, and publish status.
Contact and Sample Request submissions are visible to admins with status, owner, notes, and notification state.
Large homepage video delivery remains reviewed against Cloudflare R2 or Stream before becoming a CMS-managed default.
Media and lead workflows have clear rollback/export paths.
